caption:
Mistral AI has launched Shieldstral, a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier. This innovative model outperforms traditional safety models by up to 7x in text safety evaluations. With its unique approach to content moderation, Shieldstral sets a new standard for safety and efficiency.🌟

How do you think multimodal moderation will evolve?
